_readme: Optional overrides for the provider registry. Anything listed here wins over the built-in defaults. GET /api/providers returns the live registry including each model's input map - copy a model block from there, paste it under providers[].models[] and edit it. Restart the server after editing.

providers.id: built-in provider id, or a brand new id
providers.adapter: optional: replicate | fal | runway | luma | local | demo - reuses that provider's transport
providers.label: shown in the UI
providers.note: free text shown under the dropdown
